Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# try a few more candidates with longer names and malformed specs
cands=[b'\x1ca{b:}', b'\x1ca{b:>}', b'\x1ca{b:0}', b'\x1ca{b:100000}', b'\x1ca{b:.100000}', b'\x1ca{b:*>100000}', b'\x1ca{b!s}', b'\x1ca{b!r}', b'\x1ca{b!a}', b'\x1ca{b:^{}}']
for i,c in enumerate(cands):
    Path(f'/workspace/cand{i}.bin').write_bytes(c)
PY
for f in /workspace/cand*.bin; do echo "== $f =="; bash ./submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json | grep -E 'exit_code|trace_valid|trace_error|output' -m 1; done
